pinch-own-floor.undoes: B (H3) — a pinch uses the shared floor, not a fixed 0.2

floor-ignores-fit.undoes: B — the floor comes down to the fit, so Zoom out can get back to it

floor-ignores-current.undoes: B — the floor never sits above the zoom on screen (after the window grows)

noop-step-leaves-fit.undoes: B — a step that cannot move leaves the poster in fit mode

stale-fit-in-pinch.undoes: B — the pinch reads the current fit, not the first one

zoom-in-unclamped.undoes: B — Zoom in keeps the 10x ceiling
zoom-in-unclamped.why: reaching 10x takes 60+ clicks from a normal fit; the ceiling is ZOOM_MAX in clampZoom, shared with the pinch, and unchanged from main
